script_text: Aquarius, brace yourself — this air-charged week splits you wide open. Early week, your ruler Uranus in Gemini trines Pluto in your 1st House from your 5th House of romance, so Monday and Tuesday deliver electric attraction — say yes to those invitations. But Mars in your 4th House squares Pluto, stirring family tension and home power struggles; don't dig in Wednesday. The turning point: the Sun enters Virgo and your 8th House on August 22nd, shifting focus to shared money and intimacy. Late week, Jupiter in your 7th House opposes Pluto, forcing a partnership decision — love deepens through negotiation, while career-wise a joint venture brings gains if you compromise. Thursday is your power day, when Venus in your 9th House trines Pluto, blessing weekend travel and love confessions. Worst day: Wednesday's Mars square breeds friction. Weekly advice: lead with curiosity, not control. Follow for daily updates.
